annotations.commercial_boundary: Public MCP decision_check is a sandbox evidence-routing aid only. Production, customer-facing, investor, accelerator, NGO, DFI, enterprise, consulting, or repeated automated use of MVR API output requires licensed MVR API scoring. Separately commissioned human services use the canonical offer registry and Work With Us and do not inherently require an API key.

evidence_gaps: Add formal guardian evidence and field proof before scoring.
example_response.reason: Evidence is too thin to route to licensed scoring.

annotations.next_tool_to_call: Gather the missing proof, or route a structurally complete pack to the licensed MVR API strict decision check.
annotations.when_not_to_use: Do not use as readiness, pilot, credit, legal, regulatory, or scale authorization. Submit only consented, data-minimized, redacted or aggregated evidence; never secrets, credentials, or personal identifiers.
annotations.when_to_use: Use after evidence completeness to determine whether the pack can be routed to licensed MVR scoring or still requires proof.

description: Use after evidence completeness to route a structurally complete pack toward licensed MVR scoring or abstain on missing proof. This public tool does not compute market, pilot, or scale readiness. Use when: Use after evidence completeness to determine whether the pack can be routed to licensed MVR scoring or still requires proof. Do not use when: Do not use as readiness, pilot, credit, legal, regulatory, or scale authorization. Submit only consented, data-minimized, redacted or aggregated evidence; never secrets, credentials, or personal identifiers. Evidence input location: arguments.payload. evidence_pack: object array. String fields: evidence_type, source_class, stakeholder_class, verification_status, source_date, source_doc_id. geography: string/object; evidence_geography: object; district: nonblank string; districts: nonblank strings array. source_date/freshness_date: YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD or ISO timestamp with timezone. source_date_range: {earliest,latest}, same-precision ordered bounds within supplied dates. analysis_date stays exact. Intervals have age_days:null and age_days_min/max; unresolved window/future overlap excludes coverage. Omit unknown dates/references, never null or invented. verification_status: unverified if unchecked. *_role: original_source_record, independent_evaluation or human_attestation; else ARTIFACT_ROLE_NOT_SOURCE_EVIDENCE. collection_context + provenance_ledger: see schema/feedback. Keep adverse facts; never relabel to pass.

payload.description: Decision question, resolved subject, market scope, and evidence for a bounded recommendation or abstention.

analysis_date.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD or ISO timestamp with timezone, no later than today in analysis_timezone (UTC by default). Defaults to the current date in that calendar. Carried through the public handoff.

analysis_timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone, for example Africa/Nairobi, for the analysis calendar. Defaults to UTC; never inferred from country or IP. Date-only values keep their declared calendar day.

attestation_refs.description: Optional: https://africanmarketos.com/v1/reviewer-attestations/contract. Requires exact subject, market_scope.country and decision_question. Host-private refs outside evidence; reattach each call. No scoring or authority.

reference_secret.description: 256-bit random bearer secret. Keep host-private, out of URLs/logs/prompts/exports; grants shared context, not authority.

claims.description: Optional explicit target claims and source-specific support links. Reuses the governed claim-audit vocabulary. Public links are caller declarations, never authenticated reviewer attestations.

evidence_id.description: Must identify an item in this complete evidence pack.

locator.description: Specific page, cell or section. A locator is not proof.

review_event_id.description: Only the licensed review service can check this event; ignored as authority by public preflight.

context_freshness_window_days.description: Optional caller-declared maximum evidence age in days. No universal freshness cutoff is invented when absent; age alone does not prove validity.

decision_question.description: Exact recorded attestation question; question must agree when supplied.

decision_stage.description: Idea, pre-entry, pilot, launch, expansion, or scale stage.

evidence_available.description: Short optional context labels, not proof. For supplied document summaries use incomplete evidence_pack items instead; do not mark claims verified merely because a document exists.

evidence_items.description: Alias for evidence_pack. Supply one field, not conflicting copies.

items.description: A caller-declared, consented and redacted evidence item. No required fields at intake: incomplete items receive correction feedback. Explicit artifact_role, evidence_role, source_role, record_role and content_role declarations admit only original_source_record, independent_evaluation or human_attestation; other declared roles are rejected with ARTIFACT_ROLE_NOT_SOURCE_EVIDENCE. Omission remains supported for legacy items. Passing coverage never verifies truth, permission or readiness.

claim.description: Minimal, non-confidential claim supported by the item; do not send raw private interviews.

collection_context.description: Source-grounded collection declarations, not source authentication. Unknown facts must remain missing; do not invent values to pass. Field decision use requires source modality, collector relationship, interview mode, source-document identity and an explicit parent-source list. Collector-administered modes require staffing, duration, available minutes per collector and sample size. Group modes additionally require session_count, participants_per_session, session_duration_minutes and collectors_per_session, never inferred from an individual interview duration. Online, observation and administrative_record modes require collection_administration; self-administered online and automated observation/record sources do not need invented collector capacity. Explicit public/documentary origins are not caller fieldwork solely because evidence_type is survey; conflicting explicit field origins still block. Independent verification labels require a separate reviewer relationship; persisted review is still checked separately.

collection_administration.description: Source-grounded administration, required for online, observation and administrative_record modes. self_administered is supported for online; automated for observation or administrative_record. Face-to-face, telephone and group modes are collector-administered and cannot opt out.

collectors_per_session.description: Collectors required concurrently for each group session, drawn from enumerator_count. No default facilitator count is assumed.

fieldwork_window_minutes.description: Total available collection minutes per collector across the entire period, not daily or team-person-minutes.

interview_duration_minutes.description: Collector time per individual interview or per observed/processed sample record for collector-administered non-group modes.

participants_per_session.description: Source-grounded maximum participants in any session. Sample size cannot exceed session_count times this bound; no default group size is assumed.

session_count.description: Actual number of group sessions in the source records.

session_duration_minutes.description: Source-recorded duration of each group session in this declaration, not an alias for individual interview duration.

source_extraction.description: Optional caller-supplied second reading of source facts for conflict comparison only. Not independently authenticated; cannot supply missing primary declarations or establish source authenticity.
